name: rosetta-utf-8-encode-and-decode
code:
use default

encode(code_point: int) -> List[int] is
    let octets = LIST(4)

    if code_point < 0x80 then
        octets.add(code_point)
    elif code_point < 0x800 then
        octets.add(0xC0 | (code_point >> 6))
        octets.add(0x80 | (code_point & 0x3F))
    elif code_point < 0x10000 then
        octets.add(0xE0 | (code_point >> 12))
        octets.add(0x80 | ((code_point >> 6) & 0x3F))
        octets.add(0x80 | (code_point & 0x3F))
    else
        octets.add(0xF0 | (code_point >> 18))
        octets.add(0x80 | ((code_point >> 12) & 0x3F))
        octets.add(0x80 | ((code_point >> 6) & 0x3F))
        octets.add(0x80 | (code_point & 0x3F))
    fi

    return octets
si

decode(octets: List[int]) -> int is
    let leader = octets[0]

    let code_point mut =
        case octets.count
        when 1 then leader
        when 2 then leader & 0x1F
        when 3 then leader & 0x0F
        else leader & 0x07
        esac

    for continuation in octets |> skip(1) do
        code_point = (code_point << 6) | (continuation & 0x3F)
    od

    return code_point
si

hex(octet: int) -> string => "{octet:X2}"

row(character: string, name: string, code_point: string, octets: string)
    -> string
=>
    "{character,-11}{name,-38}{code_point,-11}{octets}"

let characters = [
    (code_point = 65, name = "LATIN CAPITAL LETTER A"),
    (code_point = 246, name = "LATIN SMALL LETTER O WITH DIAERESIS"),
    (code_point = 1046, name = "CYRILLIC CAPITAL LETTER ZHE"),
    (code_point = 8364, name = "EURO SIGN"),
    (code_point = 119070, name = "MUSICAL SYMBOL G CLEF")
]

write_line(row("character", "name", "unicode", "utf-8"))

for character in characters do
    let octets = encode(character.code_point)
    let decoded = decode(octets)

    assert decoded == character.code_point else "the round trip must agree"

    write_line(
        row(
            char.convert_from_utf32(decoded),
            character.name,
            "U+{decoded:X4}",
            octets |> map(hex) |> join(" ")))
od
